| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Orphan` keeps the external resource when the managed resource is deleted. Without `Delete` in `managementPolicies` the resource is always orphaned. One of `Delete`, `Orphan`. Default `Delete`. |
| `forProvider` | object | yes | `spec.forProvider`: the generated API fields plus references and credentials. |
| `forProvider.name` | string |  | The optional name of the key. If not provided it will be automatically generated. |
| `forProvider.projectRef` | object |  | A reference to another managed resource: a namespaced resource in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or a cluster-scoped one. |
| `forProvider.projectRef.name` | string | yes |  |
| `forProvider.rateLimit` | object |  | Applies a rate limit to cap the number of errors accepted during a given time window. To disable entirely set `rateLimit` to null. ```json { "rateLimit": { "window": 7200, // time in seconds "count": 1000 // error cap } } ``` |
| `forProvider.rateLimit.count` | integer (uint64) |  | Minimum 0. |
| `forProvider.rateLimit.window` | integer (int64) |  |  |
| `forProvider.useCase` | string |  | * `user` * `profiling` * `tempest` * `demo` One of `user`, `profiling`, `tempest`, `demo`. Default `user`. |
| `managementPolicies` | []string |  | Actions the controller may take. `["*"]` (default) allows all; `["Observe"]` only reads (import without management). `Observe` is always required. Default `["*"]`. |

Validation:

- `forProvider`: projectRef cannot be removed once set
- `forProvider.projectRef`: projectRef is immutable
